note: Pass bars for the first independent known-answer test, written down BEFORE any 2MASS J0219-3925 SPHEREx exposure was fetched or fitted. Not yet run.
object: 2MASS J0219-3925 B, companion of the M6 host 2MASS J0219-3925 A (Artigau et al. 2015, ApJ 806, 254, Table 2)

bars.expected_walk_size_arcsec: about 0.1 to 0.15 (from the calibrated 8.5 arcsec response); a walk under 0.05 arcsec is a fail to detect, not a contradiction
bars.walk_significance: report the Rayleigh p_false with the measured floors (0.049 E, 0.066 N); no sigma bar is promised because the walk may be below the floor
bars.per_visit_walk_directions: each visit's sky-frame walk within 40 degrees of 174, and the detector-frame angle differing between visits that have opposite roll
bars.controls: ratio at the true place minus the median of off-peak angles (at least 75 degrees from the walk) of the 15-degree PA scan, with the off-peak scatter as the error; no absolute 0.02 bar

prerequisites_before_running: controls and PA scan in the detector frame (not done)
reference-star subtraction for hosts with two or more field stars in the cutout (not done)
